title: Implement compute(a, b) arithmetic mean feature with helper and tests
description: Implement compute(a, b) in src/main.py returning the arithmetic mean of two finite numeric inputs (e.g., compute(2, 3) == 2.5), supporting zero, negative and fractional values. The mean logic must live in mean_values(a, b) in src/helper.py and be imported/used by src/main.py. Add tests/test_compute.py with a unittest asserting compute(2, 3) == 2.5. Validate with checks/public_check.py and build via python -m compileall -q src.
